acceptance_gate: routed query p95 within 100 ms at 100K with a fresh index; auto without a daemon within 1 ms of direct

machine.host: designated evaluation host (Intel Core i7-10700, 31 GiB RAM, Debian 13)

setup: Isolated XDG_CONFIG_HOME and XDG_STATE_HOME; daemon.toml binds 127.0.0.1:0
Both fixtures scanned, then registered with `vault add --no-sync`
`daemon start --detach`, then waited until both vaults reported cache state fresh

queries: from notes where type = task and status = active order by title limit 50
from notes where status = open limit 20
from notes order by file.path desc limit 10
method.timing: wall clock of the whole process from Python subprocess.run; 11 runs per query, the first discarded; 30 samples per size and route
method.refresh: default refresh mode: direct runs prove freshness by stat walk; routed runs pass an index barrier
method.equivalence: stdout of the second run of each query compared between direct and daemon

auto_overhead.method: daemon stopped; 10K fixture, `from notes where status = open limit 20`; interleaved direct, auto, direct, auto; 31 runs each, first discarded; median per block

limitations: Measured right after a release build finished; load was elevated, which slows both routes
No concurrent writers or external edits during measurement
Equivalence compares one run's stdout per query, not every sample
Host power, frequency, background load, and OS page cache are uncontrolled
